Assistance to Japanese Military Police and S.P.O.
(S.M. Police).

At 12 noon 30/1/38 D.I. Nakamura and D.S.I. Umemato
S.P.O. (S.M. Police) attended this (Sinza) Station and
reported to the undersigned that Japanese Military
Police would require assistance to raid and search a
house in this district, for hand grenades which were
being used in the intimidation of various persons, at
about 7 a.m. 31/1/38.

The undersigned informed D.D.O. "B" Div. and
received instructions to conduct raid and search when
Japanese Military Police attended the station.

At 7 a.m. 31/1/38 Sergeant Major Katoda and 3
assistants of the Japanese Military Police, D.I. Nakamura,
D.S.I. Umemato and D.S. Ando of the S.P.O. (S.M. Police)
attended this station, to obtain the necessary
assistance.

Assistance was given by D.I. Eddy, D.S. Haskell,
C.D.S.188, C.D.C's 135, 205, 326 and at 7.10 a.m.
31/1/38 Chinese dwelling house No.30, Lane No.331 Tatung
Road was raided. A search of 3 upper rooms and covered
in drying stage resulted in the finding of documents in
a wardrobe in a bedroom which Sergeant Major Takada
stated he required. He further stated that he already
possessed documents implicating the male occupant of the
room, who was sleeping there with his wife, one,

协助日本宪兵队及特别政治办公室
（上海公共租界警务处）。

1938年1月30日中午12时，特别政治办公室（上海公共租界警务处）的警探长 Nakamura 和副警探长 Umemato 来到本局（新闸），向具名者报告称，日本宪兵队需要协助，拟于1938年1月31日上午7时左右，突击搜查本辖区内的一处住宅，查找被用于恐吓各人士的手榴弹。

具名者通知了“B”区副总监，并接到指示，待日本宪兵队到达警局时，配合进行突击搜查。

1938年1月31日上午7时，日本宪兵队的军曹长 Katoda 及3名助手，以及特别政治办公室（上海公共租界警务处）的警探长 Nakamura、副警探长 Umemato 和副警探 Ando 来到本局，以获取必要的协助。

由警探长 Eddy、副警探 Haskell、华籍副警探188号、华籍巡捕135号、205号、326号提供协助。1938年1月31日上午7时10分，对大同路331弄30号的华人住宅进行了突击搜查。在对三楼房间及晒台进行搜索后，在卧室的一个衣柜里发现了文件，军曹长 Takada 表示这些文件是他所需要的。他还表示，他已经掌握了牵涉该房间男性居住者的文件，当时他正与其妻子睡在那里，此人名为，

Joh Dan Su (      ), age 55, native of King
[ illegible ] proprietor.

An extensive search failed to find hand grenades
arms and/or ammunition.

When questioned, Joh Dan Su denied being connected
any military or political body and denied receiving
concealing hand grenades, arms or ammunition at the
address stating that he and his wife, who together own
110 rickshas, had lived at the address as proprietors of
ricksha house 374 Shenhailwan Road for 12 years. A visit
to 374 Shenhailwan Rd proved this statement to be
correct.

Sergeant Major Tatao, through D.I. Nakamura
requested the handing over of Joh Dan Su for enquiry.

The facts of the case were explained to D.I.
Div. Mr. Baker at 8.30 a.m. 31/1/38 who sanctioned
handing over of Joh Dan Su, instructing that D.I.
Nakamura S.P.O. inform this station re the disposal
Joh Dan Su. The documents, now in the hands of Japanese
Military Police, were not translated at this station
the undersigned deeming it inadvisable. Joh Dan Su was
handed over at 8.40 a.m. 31/1/38.

Joh Dan Su（音译），55岁，籍贯 King [原文不清]，业主。

经过广泛搜查，未发现手榴弹、武器和/或弹药。

经讯问，Joh Dan Su 否认与任何军事或政治团体有关联，也否认在该地址接收或藏匿手榴弹、武器或弹药，声称他和妻子共同拥有110辆人力车，作为申海弯路374号人力车房的业主，已在此地址居住12年。经走访申海弯路374号，证实该陈述属实。

军曹长 Tatao 通过警探长 Nakamura 要求移交 Joh Dan Su 以便审讯。

1938年1月31日上午8时30分，向分区警探长 Baker 先生说明了案情，他批准移交 Joh Dan Su，并指示特别政治办公室警探长 Nakamura 就 Joh Dan Su 的处理情况通知本局。目前由日本宪兵队持有的文件未在本局翻译，具名者认为此举不妥。Joh Dan Su 于1938年1月31日上午8时40分被移交。

MORE ARRESTS OF
TERRORISTS

Japanese Paper Describes
Round-up

One alleged ringleader and several
other Chinese accused of complicity
in anti-Japanese terroristic activities
were arrested by Japanese constables
of the S.M.P. in a raid in the Settle-
ment early in the morning of Jan-
uary 31, the New Year Day by lunar
reckoning, the "Shanghai Nippo"
revealed yesterday.
Although the place where the
round-up occurred and the names of
those seized were not disclosed by
the paper, they were reported to have
been members of the Woosung and
Shanghai volunteer corps.
In a house where the Chinese were
seized were found several pieces of
telegraph apparatus of excellent make
and a file of instructions for carrying
out anti-Japanese practices, the paper
said.
Two of those arrested were said to
have been paid $30 apiece for an
undisclosed terroristic act. One of
these, the paper said, returned to the
lair after abandoning in Nantao sev-
eral hand grenades which he had
been ordered to hurl at objectives of
the terrorists' campaign.
This man gave up the project, the
daily stated, because he became
worried by the strict precautions
being taken by the Japanese military
and police authorities.
pages.zh:
更多恐怖分子被捕

日文报纸描述
抓捕行动

据《上海日报》昨日披露，在农历新年元旦（1月31日）清晨，上海公共租界警务处的日本巡捕在一次租界内的突袭行动中，逮捕了一名涉嫌反日恐怖活动的主谋及其他几名被控共谋的中国男子。
尽管该报未披露抓捕发生的具体地点及被捕者姓名，但据报道他们是吴淞和上海义勇队的成员。
该报称，在抓获这些中国人的房屋内，发现了数件制作精良的电报设备，以及一份实施反日活动的指令文件。
据说，被捕者中有两人因实施一项未公开的恐怖行为而各获酬金30美元。该报称，其中一人在南市丢弃了奉命投掷到恐怖运动目标处的几枚手榴弹后，返回了巢穴。
该日报称，此人放弃了该计划，是因为他对日本军方和警察当局采取的严密预防措施感到担忧。

pages.en:
Several Chinese Nabbed
Here For Anti-Nippon
Terroristic Activities

Several Chinese, alleged to have
been involved in anti-Japanese ter-
roristic activities, were arrested by
Japanese constables of the Shang-
hai Municipal Police in a raid in
the Settlement on the morning of
January 31, according to a report
appearing in the Shanghai Nippo
yesterday. The paper added that
one of the Chinese arrested was a
ringleader in anti-Japanese activi-
ties.

The arrested men are reported to
have been members of the Woosung
and Shanghai Special Service Corps
but neither their names nor the
place where they were arrested was
revealed. It was stated, however,
that several pieces of telegraph
apparatus and a file of instructions
for carrying out anti-Japanese
activities were found on the pre-
mises where the raid was made.
pages.zh:
数名中国人在此因反日
恐怖活动被捕

据昨日《上海日报》刊登的一篇报道，1月31日上午，上海公共租界警务处的日本巡捕在租界内的一次突袭行动中，逮捕了数名涉嫌参与反日恐怖活动的中国人。该报补充说，被捕的中国人中有一人是反日活动的主谋。

据报道，被捕人员是吴淞和上海特别服务队的成员，但他们的姓名及被捕地点均未透露。不过，报道称，在突袭行动的现场发现了数件电报设备和一份实施反日活动的指令文件。

Nippo :-

TERRORIST LEADERS ARRESTED BY JAPANESE MEMBERS OF S.M.P.

On Chinese new year day, Japanese members of
the Special Political Office raided a certain place and
arrested a terrorist leader who is said to be the battalion
commander of the Shanghai-Woosung Volunteer Guerrilla Corps
and several other members of the gang.
pages.zh:
《上海日报》：

恐怖分子头目被上海公共租界警务处日本成员逮捕

在中国农历新年当天，特别政治办公室的日本成员突袭了一处地点，逮捕了一名恐怖分子头目，据说他是上海-吴淞志愿游击队的大队长，以及该团伙的其他几名成员。

Japanese Military Police operating
in District.
------------------
At 6.20 a.m. on the 19-2-38, D.S.I. Mikhlaevsky,
D.S.I. Yamamoto attached to S.F.S. in company with 2
members of the Japanese Military Police, attended this
station, prior to proceeding to an address on Wei Hai Wei
Road in order to effect the arrest of a Formasan#, wanted
by the Japanese Military Authorities for subversive acti-
vities.

The detective party proceeded to House No. 79, Foo
Ayih Li (福義), Wei Hai Wei Road, but the person required
was not known or on the premises.

Due to the abortive nature of the raid no further
action was taken, and the party left this district.

It is not known if any further attempts will be made
to effect the arrest of the person wanted in this district,
whose name was not divulged by the authorities concerned.

日本宪兵队在本辖区行动。
---
1938年2月19日上午6时20分，附属於特别法医股（S.F.S.）的副警探长 Mikhlaevsky、副警探长 Yamamoto 与两名日本宪兵队成员一同来到本局，随后前往威海卫路的一处地址，旨在逮捕一名被日本军方当局通缉从事颠覆活动的台湾人#。

侦探小组前往威海卫路福义里79号，但所需抓捕之人不在该处，亦无人知晓其下落。

由于突袭未果，未采取进一步行动，该小组离开了本辖区。

目前尚不知是否会再次尝试在本辖区逮捕该通缉犯，相关当局未透露其姓名。

Bubbling Well
STN.REP.70/38.    22nd. February    38.
1.

ASSISTANCE TO JAPANESE MILITARY POLICE.

At 3p.m. 22.2.38 Mr.J.I.Fuji of the Japanese Consular
Police, telephoned Bubbling Well Station and stated that a
party of Japanese Military Police would come to the station
and request assistance to visit an address in Hwakee Avenue,
B'Well Road.

（批：Japanese suspect & delay action as possible.）
（印：RECEIVED 22 FEB 1938 ...）

At 3.30p.m. Warrant Officer M.Y.Ishida i/c of a party of
J.M.Police came to the station. He stated that they wished
to visit House 16, Hwakee Avenue, Room No.15, to obtain from
a Korean girl Miss T.J.Kin some letters written to her by a
Japanese soldier who is suspected of communism.

S.I.Darvill, S.I.Yamaguchi and the undersigned rendered
assistance. At the above address it was learned that Miss
T.J.Kin had recently left for Korea. Her sister Miss S.J.
Kin, who occupies the same room, handed to the Japanese
Military Police three letters which had been written to her

警局报告 70/38。    1938年2月22日。
1.

协助日本宪兵队。

1938年2月22日下午3时，日本领事馆警察的 J.I. Fuji 先生致电静安寺警局，称一队日本宪兵队将来到警局，请求协助前往赫基路（Hwakee Avenue）、静安寺路的一处地址。

（批注：日本嫌疑人 & 尽可能拖延行动。）
（印章：1938年2月22日收到 ...）

下午3时30分，日本宪兵队一队负责人准尉 M.Y. Ishida 来到警局。他表示，他们希望前往赫基路16号15室，从一名朝鲜女子 T.J. Kin 小姐处获取一名涉嫌共产主义的日本士兵写给她的信件。

警探 Darvill、警探 Yamaguchi 和具名者提供了协助。在上述地址得知，T.J. Kin 小姐最近已前往朝鲜。住在同一房间的她的妹妹 S.J. Kin 小姐，向日本宪兵队移交了该士兵写给她姐姐的三封信。未进行搜查或其他行动。

（批注：无需特别股。）
